args.prompt: Create one production 2D combat animation sprite sheet of THE PAIN from ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 3 Snake Eater (2004 PS2). Closest 1:1 ORIGINAL costume/anatomy supported by the supplied canonical Shinkawa drawing and Konami original game-model color image. Never remake/Delta. Huge stocky muscular broad-shouldered middle-aged man, head proportionately small. Phase ONE fully covered head: dark charcoal tight BALACLAVA covering head, mouth and nose with only narrow flesh strip at eyes, no bare face and no gas mask. ORIGINAL color image overrides monochrome interpretation: full black/charcoal long sleeved padded/textured field suit, orange ochre/yellow sleeveless flotation-like heavy chest vest with straps and dark gray upper shoulder protection, 2 horizontal ochre cartridge rows across the chest/belly, ochre rectangular pouches at hips/back, black wide belt, dark gray trousers reinforced knees, black combat gloves and plain black tall boots. Keep recognizable original rounded massive torso, broad thick upper arms, tight black head and ochre front breast panel. NO bare arms, armor redesign, helmet, scarf, goggles, modern military plates, weapons, guns, magic, horns, bee aura or floating insects on body. Crisp ink contour and restrained detailed cel shaded polished fighting game artwork, readable dark contour on true transparent alpha, consistent costume and scale, exact head and fully visible boots. Output ONE PNG: exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 entirely isolated full body figures, one per equal cell, no touching. All characters face SCREEN RIGHT (nose, chest and front foot face right), mild side three-quarter so vest remains visible; do not mix directions. Leave large TRANSPARENT OUTER MARGINS and broad transparent gutters, each full figure stays within own cell even hands/feet, never clipped. No labels, text, boxes, checkerboard, background, ground shadows. These are first-phase masked The Pain control gestures, no second-phase disfigured face or mouth attack. No detached hornets/particles or glow are baked into sprites; floating hornets are rendered separately by engine. Row-major poses: 0 grapple preparation BOTH gloves forward at chest; 1 grapple ACTIVE both gloved hands reach forward to SCREEN RIGHT fingers curved without a second person; 2 COMMAND SWARM startup right palm close to chest facing forward; 3 COMMAND SWARM ACTIVE right ARM FULLY EXTENDED HORIZONTALLY toward SCREEN RIGHT, fingers OPEN at sternum height, palm facing down/outward, left hand at waist; 4 command swarm recovery right elbow bends toward chest; 5 protective swarm shield shoulders tall both arms raised palms outward just at shoulder width fingers open; 6 protective swarm shield active arms firmly held chest level palms outward; 7 surveying eye gesture one gloved hand near brow, NO uncovered face, no goggles; 8 replenishment breathing shoulders dropped both fists beside abdomen; 9 replenishment settling shoulders upright hands relaxed; 10 strong SWARM BARRAGE startup right palm beside chest left palm lifts; 11 SWARM BARRAGE ACTIVE right arm fully extends STRAIGHT FORWARD TO SCREEN RIGHT horizontally at chest level, open fingers outward palm slightly down, left palm stays raised near chest. CQC actions authored from original swarm-control gestures, true alpha, 12 separate full bodies.
